chibi-ice-folk-monument.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:ICE_FOLK
chibi-ice-folk-monument.notes: Reused candidate 9 of the Ice Folk Explorer sheet (explorer-a), no new PixelLab job (the US$5 limit left no room for obelisk-a). A tall slender obelisk of clear pale ice blue on a low square foot, shaded on its right; no compass rose, no spyglass, no other motif, so it shows the Ice Folk builder and hides the achievement. It is ice rather than snow-capped stone: the snowy stone pieces of the sheet (0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, 14) all carry the rose. Muster-a 8 (a bare snowy stone post) was the other choice and reads as a stub at 1:1.

chibi-ice-folk-monument-conqueror.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:ICE_FOLK:CONQUEROR
chibi-ice-folk-monument-conqueror.notes: Candidate 0 of 16: a small arch of white snow blocks with an open gateway, a big laurel wreath of ice-blue crystal leaves on its lintel and a crossed bone spear and harpoon on its front; the Conqueror's arch and wreath in Ice Folk snow and ice, lit from the left. The sixteen are near twins; 6, 7 and 11 have a crown of ice shards or a skull in place of the wreath or the weapons.

chibi-ice-folk-monument-engineer.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:ICE_FOLK:ENGINEER
chibi-ice-folk-monument-engineer.notes: Candidate 6 of 16: a square pale grey stone pillar dusted with snow, lit on its left face, topped by a big ivory bone cogwheel standing on its edge, with a crossed bone hammer and ice pick with an ice-blue head on its front; the Engineer's cog and crossed tools in Ice Folk stone, bone and ice. All sixteen are now lit from the left; 0, 4, 7 and 12 have a pink pillar, 1, 5, 9 and 13 a blue one, off the faction's palette.

chibi-ice-folk-monument-explorer.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:ICE_FOLK:EXPLORER
chibi-ice-folk-monument-explorer.notes: Candidate 1 of 16: a pale grey stone obelisk under a thick snow cap, a bone compass rose with an ice-blue star on its front and a bone spyglass at its foot; the Explorer's compass and spyglass in Ice Folk stone, snow and bone, lit from the left. 5 and 12 have the rose but no spyglass; 0, 2, 9, 14 a small rose on a thin needle; 4 and 7 dark stone; 8, 10 and 13 lose the snow or the rose.

chibi-ice-folk-monument-land-baron.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:ICE_FOLK:LAND_BARON
chibi-ice-folk-monument-land-baron.notes: Candidate 13 of 16: a stout pale stone boundary stone with a carved shield bearing a mammoth, a crown of ice-blue crystals on its snowy top and a bone signpost with two arrow boards; the Land Baron's crowned boundary stone and signpost in Ice Folk stone and ice, lit from the left. 0, 2, 8 and 15 are close; 1, 5, 9 tall crystal heaps that read less as a crown; 4, 6, 11 no crown.
